name: Robataya OTON
notes: Restaurant's own domain (robatayaotonsd.com) is an Owner.com site. The live /menu ordering page exposes only ONE category ('Take Out', 8 items) via its JSON-LD/state -- not the full dine-in menu -- so used the linked 'Menu PDF' (found via /page/menu-pdf) instead, which is the complete dine-in menu. Paired names to prices with pdftotext -raw (cross-checked against -layout; both agreed on ordering for every section used) since -layout stretches item names into letter-spaced text (e.g. 'K A N P A C H I') that is still legible. Cross-checked 5 overlapping items (Unagi Don, Hokkai Don/Hokkaido Bowl, Bara Chirashi, Japanese Style Uni Noodle, Seafood Salad) against the live Take Out ordering page and all 5 prices matched exactly, confirming the PDF is current. Address on PDF/site: 5447 Kearny Villa Rd, San Diego, CA, matching the work list. Captured Omakase, Sushi, Sashimi, This Weeks Catch (seasonal nigiri), Grilled Kama Selection, Otsumami (Starters), Entrees, Hot Pot, two Sake sections (by-the-glass ladder and Kenji's bottle selection), Soft Drinks, Beer, Shochu, Chu-hi, and Dessert. Recorded the Sake by-the-glass items' full 4oz/10oz/24oz (or stated) ladders since each size was directly read off the PDF, not inferred from a pattern. Chu-hi shows a single $10 price header covering all four listed flavors. Omitted the WINE section entirely: its 3 items (Plum Wine, Yuzu Wine, Green Tea Plum) and the run of $8/glass, $10/glass, +$1, $15/glass, $50/bottle price tokens do not pair unambiguously under either -layout or -raw -- a genuine multi-column PDF scramble, not guessed. Also omitted a 'catering' nav item as an adjunct (not fetched).
